تهتدوا (form VIII)
# تَهْتَدُوا (tahtadū) /tah.ta.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِهْتَدَى (ihtadā)
# تُهْتَدَوْا (tuhtadaw) /tuh.ta.daw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِهْتَدَى (ihtadā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
